title: Silver Creek Fire Assistance
body:
For the entire month of May TIDE Rangers have been on 24/7 standby – assisting villages in Toledo where fire has threatened farms, houses, and communities.

Last night Federico Caal managed to film a few clips of them working to out fire close to the village of Silver Creek. Lenard Teul explains why they need to chop the cohune trees.

Video Credit Federico Caal.
